domain_analysis.scope: Interior NC wood ceiling stain/clear for 3 styles (plank, beadboard, coffered)
key_differences_from_wood_wall_stain: ALL work is overhead — base rates include 0.80-0.85x penalty vs wood wall
Height modifier applies ON TOP of overhead penalty (H1-H3)
Coffered adds 1.35x (vs wall panel 1.00x) — beam faces + panel fields + inside corners
Fixture masking always required (ceiling fixtures embedded in work surface)
Spray strongly preferred — faster and more ergonomic overhead
Gravity effects on stain dripping more pronounced — careful wipe technique critical
Gel stain advantageous overhead — thicker formula reduces dripping

production_rate_analysis.overhead_penalty_method: Base rates are approximately 0.80-0.85x of equivalent wood wall stain rates. This penalty accounts for gravity effects, physical strain, ladder repositioning, and slower tool handling overhead.

risk_notes.risk: Stain runs and drips due to gravity on horizontal overhead surface
risk_notes.mitigation: Spray is preferred. Gel stain reduces drip risk. Thin coats. Immediate wipe.

risk_notes.risk: Clear coat sags at joint grooves and coffered beam edges
risk_notes.mitigation: Thin coats. Spray preferred. Check 5 min after application for sags.
